title: Targeted Discovery of a Novel Carrageenan-Binding Module with High Affinity through Computational Screening.
authors: Du, Jiawei; Sun, Menghui; Chen, Fangyi; Zheng, Long; Gong, Hongfang; Chang, Yaoguang; Xue, Changhu
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构预测与分子动力学模拟的计算筛选策略，发现新型卡拉胶结合模块AmCBM116，虽对象为多糖结合蛋白而非典型蛋白结构计算，但方法框架可迁移至蛋白质结构相关计算研究。
abstract: Carrageenan is a sulfated red algal polysaccharide widely used in food for its gelling and thickening properties. High-affinity recognition tools are needed for food quality control, and carbohydrate-binding modules (CBMs) are promising recognition elements. However, high-affinity carrageenan-specific CBMs remain scarce. Here, we developed a computationally driven screening strategy integrating structure prediction and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations for targeted high-affinity CBM discovery through binding free energy calculations prior to experimental validation. Using this strategy, a novel CBM designated AmCBM116 was identified from iota-carrageenases of the GH82 family. AmCBM116 specifically recognizes both kappa- and iota-carrageenan with high affinity, with association constants (Ka) of 1.97 x 105 M-1 and 1.82 x 106 M-1, respectively. Key residues involved in ligand recognition were identified. AmCBM116 and its homologues reveal a novel CBM family, CBM116. This study expands the carrageenan-binding CBMs and provides a framework for the targeted discovery of high-affinity polysaccharide-binding modules.
abstract_zh: 卡拉胶是一种硫酸化红藻多糖，因其胶凝和增稠特性而广泛用于食品中。食品质量控制需要高亲和力的识别工具，而碳水化合物结合模块（CBMs）是有前景的识别元件。然而，高亲和力的卡拉胶特异性CBMs仍然稀缺。在此，我们开发了一种计算驱动的筛选策略，整合了结构预测和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，通过结合自由能计算在实验验证之前进行靶向高亲和力CBM发现。利用该策略，从GH82家族的iota-卡拉胶酶中鉴定出一个新型CBM，命名为AmCBM116。AmCBM116特异性识别kappa-和iota-卡拉胶，具有高亲和力，其结合常数（Ka）分别为1.97 x 105 M-1和1.82 x 106 M-1。鉴定了参与配体识别的关键残基。AmCBM116及其同源物揭示了一个新的CBM家族，CBM116。本研究扩展了卡拉胶结合CBMs，并为靶向发现高亲和力多糖结合模块提供了框架。
